title: Checklist surface renders on the dashboard when application-dashboard is applied and on the settings page when not
asA: returning principal who dismissed the tour and later wants to check the outstanding items
iWant: the checklist to render on the dashboard shell when application-dashboard is applied and on the settings page when it is not, with a collapse contract that opens the checklist on the dashboard and closes it on the settings page by default
soThat: the checklist meets me where I am, and it does not intrude on the settings surface where it is a reference rather than a primary task

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the applied capability set includes application-dashboard, the checklist renders inside a <details open> element on the dashboard-top anchor slot; given the applied capability set does NOT include application-dashboard, the checklist renders inside a <details> (closed) element on the settings-page anchor slot; the <details> element carries data-role="onboarding-tour-checklist" in both branches. Anchors to TAC-2702-application-onboarding-tour-checklist-slot; probed by application-onboarding-tour.pack.mjs check AC-26103-1 on both application-dashboard and settings-page branches.
